name: Friuch

attributes.attribute: kept the hogs for the magician Bodb Derg
became a great bull at the end

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Friuch is a figure of Irish legend. He kept the hogs for the magician Bodb Derg. His rival Rucht tended the pigs of Ochall Ochne. The two held hate for each other. With each new life they returned in a form that matched the other. They fought in the air, on the land, and in the sea. They passed through many lives as beasts and men. In the final stage they rose as the two great bulls of Ireland. The white-horned bull met the brown bull, and both fell.

okr.objective: Friuch carries a feud of rebirth against his rival Rucht.
